app.translationNote: This Burmese translation is a machine-assisted first pass. Its caveat wording is awaiting review by a Burmese speaker; where it is unclear, the English is authoritative.
app.devHint: Developing locally? Start the API with {command}, or point {variable} at a running instance (currently {url}).

banners.wakingTitle: Waking the server - this can take up to a minute
banners.wakingBody: Amber's API runs on a free hosting tier that sleeps when nobody is using it. The first request after a pause starts it up again; this page keeps retrying on its own.

errors.genericDetail: The app hit an unexpected problem. Retrying usually fixes it.
errors.unreachableTitle: The Amber API is not responding
errors.unreachableDetail: It may still be waking up, or be offline. Check your connection and retry. (API: {url})
errors.serverTitle: The Amber API had a problem
errors.serverDetail: The server failed to answer this request. Retrying may help; the other views still work.
errors.unexpectedTitle: Unexpected response from the Amber API
errors.lastGood: What is shown is the last result that loaded.
errors.viewTitle: This view could not be shown
errors.viewBody: Something failed while loading it. If the site was updated a moment ago, reloading the page fetches the new version; the other views may still work.

controls.viewTable: View the data as a table
controls.leversHint: Multipliers on reform-era behaviour: 1.0 = as calibrated. They act from {year}.

honesty.sdNotCredibleTitle: Illustrative dynamics, not a calibrated projection
honesty.backtestFailed: Illustrative dynamics only: the model failed its backtest gate.
honesty.fitNotCredible: Illustrative only: the pre-coup fit is not credible, so the gap is not an effect estimate.
honesty.gapNotReported: The {year} gap is not reported: without a credible pre-{treatment} fit it measures the fit's failure, not an effect.
honesty.estimateNotForecast: against synthetic {country}: an estimate, not a forecast
honesty.headline: By {year}, {country}'s real GDP per capita was {gap} ({share}) against a synthetic {country} built from its peers - an estimate against a constructed comparison, not a forecast.
honesty.notOverlaid: Phase 3's counterfactual for this series is not credible, so it is not overlaid.
honesty.modelOutputs: Model outputs under stated assumptions: what they would imply, not what will happen.
honesty.illustrativeScenarioTitle: Illustrative scenario, not a causal estimate
honesty.illustrationNotEstimate: {path} on the path against {actual} actual - an illustration, not an estimate
honesty.gapAttributesNoCause: The shaded gap shows how far the two trajectories separated. It bundles every difference between the two - policy, conflict, prices, measurement - and attributes it to no cause.
honesty.hollowSummary: Hollow points mark scores computed from partial indicator coverage.
honesty.hollowHistorySummary: Hollow history points are scored from partial indicator coverage.
honesty.lowReliabilitySummary: {country}'s values before {year} are low reliability, drawn dotted over hatching.
honesty.windowKey: Modeling window ({year}+): scope, not data quality
honesty.windowSummary: A bracket marks the modeling window from {year}.

charts.lineChart: Line chart of {what}, {from}–{to}, one line per country.
charts.extremes: In {year} the highest is {top} ({topValue}) and the lowest {bottom} ({bottomValue}).
charts.sourceWdi: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators.

overview.title: Two timelines, side by side.
overview.description: Amber reconstructs {country}'s development since the reform era, estimates what the {year} coup cost against a synthetic comparison, and lets you explore what could still happen.
overview.layersDescription: Each layer answers one question with its own method; one development index measures all three.
overview.pastMethod: Real indicator series and a combined development index whose pillar weights you set.
overview.counterfactualQuestion: What if the February {year} coup had not happened?
overview.counterfactualMethod: A synthetic {country}: a weighted blend of regional peers fitted to {country} before {year}.
overview.futureMethod: A calibrated system-dynamics model with stability and policy levers - scenarios, not forecasts.

gdp.title: {name}, {start}–{end}
gdp.subtitle: {country} against the {n} peers of the donor pool. Constant 2015 US$ on a log scale, so equal slopes are equal growth rates.
gdp.interpolated: {n} values are interpolated across interior gaps, not observed.

past.title: What happened since {year}
past.description: Real indicator series for {country} and its peers. Pre-{year} military-era statistics are left out: they are not reliable enough to build on.
past.indexDescription: The combined index is a weighted geometric mean of three pillars, so a strong pillar cannot mask a weak one. Set the weights; the API recomputes the index live.
past.chartSubtitle: Scored against fixed goalposts (0.01–1), so every year and country sits on the same ruler. Weights applied: {weights}.
past.partialNote: {country}'s score is partial from {from}: by {to} it rests on {share} of its indicators.
past.builtFrom: Built from {n} of the panel's {total} indicators. {excluded} stay as history only: no counterfactual or projection can produce them.
past.source: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators; Amber's index.
past.tableCaption: Combined development index by year and country, weights {weights}
past.inputTitle: These weights cannot produce an index

counterfactual.title: What if the {year} coup had not happened?
counterfactual.description: No country shows what {country} would have looked like without the coup, so Amber builds one: a weighted blend of peers that did not rupture in {year}, matched to {country} before it. These are estimates against a constructed comparison, precomputed and never refitted on request.
counterfactual.mainSummary: Line chart of {outcome}, {from}–{to}: {country} and synthetic {country}, a blend of donors fitted before {treatment}. In {to}, {country} is {actual} and synthetic {country} {synthetic}.{caveat}
counterfactual.mainTable: {outcome}: {country}, synthetic {country} and the gap, by year{suffix}
counterfactual.mainNote: Synthetic {country} is a convex blend of donors fitted to {start}–{end}; after {treatment} the gap between the lines is the estimate.
counterfactual.placeboRankDetail: p = {p}; the smallest possible with {n} units is {floor}
counterfactual.placeboSubtitle: Each donor refitted as if it had been treated in {year}. A real effect should stand out from the gray.
counterfactual.poorFitNote: Faint and dashed: {names} - pre-fit error over {multiple}× {country}'s; still counted in the p-value.
counterfactual.placeboSummary: Line chart of the gap between each unit and its synthetic control, {country} against {n} placebo donors refitted as if treated in {treatment}. {country} ranks {rank} on post/pre fit ratio (p = {p}).{poor}{caveat}
counterfactual.placeboTable: Gap from synthetic control by year: {country} and each placebo{suffix}
counterfactual.weightsSubtitle: Donor weights; they are non-negative and sum to 100%.
counterfactual.weightsSummary: Bar chart of donor weights, which are non-negative and sum to 100%: {weights}.{caveat}

future.title: What could still happen, to {year}
future.description: Pick a path for stability, then move the policy levers: each change re-runs the calibrated model live. It is never refitted.
future.consistent: Over {from}–{to} this path runs up to {deviation} from phase 3's synthetic control, within the {tolerance} tolerance.
future.inconsistent: Over {from}–{to} this path runs up to {deviation} from phase 3's synthetic control, beyond the {tolerance} tolerance: read it as optimistic.
future.notCompared: Phase 3's synthetic control is not overlaid or compared: {reason}
future.composition: History scores only the indicators {country} reports (hollow points); scenarios score all of them. In {year} that alone lifts the modeled index by {gap} - a composition step, not a scenario effect.
future.paired: Paired member by member, this scenario ends {p50} against {baseline} in {year} (p10–p90 {p10} to {p90}), above it in {share} of members.
future.ensemble: Bands span p10–p90 of a {n}-member ensemble. {count} parameters the data cannot pin down ({labels}) are spread over their plausible ranges, with history refitted at each.
future.ensembleSteep: Bands span p10–p90 of a {n}-member ensemble. {count} parameters the data cannot pin down ({labels}) are spread over their plausible ranges, with history refitted at each - and at least one profile node fits worse than tolerance.
future.summaryFan: Fan chart of {label} under the {scenario} scenario, {from}–{to}: the median and the p10–p90 range of a {n}-member ensemble.
future.summaryEnd: In {year} the median is {p50}, with p10 {p10} and p90 {p90}.
future.tableCaption: {label}, {scenario}: history and the ensemble's p10, median and p90 by year{suffix}
future.chartSubtitle: The band starts in {from}, where this scenario leaves history; levers act from {start}.
future.notInTrajectory: This series is not in the trajectory.
future.playerDescription: {country}'s World Bank history to {year}, then this scenario's ensemble median. The bars are the model's pillar scores on the goalpost scale.
future.playerDescriptionTick: {country}'s World Bank history to {year}, then this scenario's ensemble median. The bars are the model's pillar scores on the goalpost scale; the tick marks {baseline}.
future.isBaseline: This is the baseline scenario itself.

history.title: How {country} got here, {start}–{end}
history.description: Descriptive history from the first year the World Bank publishes, on one ruler. Nothing here is fitted: the combined index, the counterfactual and the scenarios stay in their {year}+ modeling window.
history.divergenceDescription: An illustration with stated assumptions: {country}'s actual {year} level, grown at a comparator's actual growth rates.
history.subtitle: {country} and {others} on one ruler: {units}, log scale, so equal slopes are equal growth. Hatched years are low reliability; the bracket marks the modeling window.
history.source: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (constant 2015 US$).
history.summary: Line chart of {name} on a log scale, {from}–{to}, for {countries}.
history.maddisonSubtitle: A different ruler: GDP per capita in {units}. Not comparable with the constant-US$ line above, so it is never joined to it.
history.maddisonSource: Source: Maddison Project Database 2023 (Bolt and van Zanden 2024), CC BY 4.0.
history.maddisonSummary: Line chart of {country}'s GDP per capita in {units}, {from}–{to}, from the Maddison Project. A different ruler from the World Bank series; every value is low reliability.
history.sensitivity: Anchor-sensitive: started in {years} instead, the path ends at {ratios} actual.
history.comparatorDescription: The path starts at {country}'s actual {year} level and grows at the comparator's actual annual rates.
history.chartTitle: {country} and an illustrative path: {comparator}'s growth since {year}
history.chartSource: Source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (constant 2015 US$); Amber's illustrative path.
history.chartSummary: Line chart, log scale, {from}–{to}: {country}'s actual GDP per capita against an illustrative path that grows its {from} level at {comparator}'s actual growth rates. By {to} the path is {ratio} the actual level ({path} against {actual}). {title}. {sensitivity}
history.chartSummaryLoading: {title}: the divergence path has not loaded yet.
history.divergenceTable: {country}'s actual GDP per capita and the illustrative {comparator}-tracking path (constant 2015 US$)
